Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He suddenly freezes, mouth ajar, as if caught in a lie. Or maybe he's just shocked at your audacity to suggest something like that.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I have too much dignité for that ! I am relaying to you what I was told by those with less ... erm, respect de soi.

Line.Text: Nonetheless, it is more reason to stay away from that place. The fact that its creators cannot take pride in their cooking.
